text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While having a meeting with Copano Rickey 
in the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Ow ow ow... Urrgh, this is bad.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a little bit. It's been hurting since 
this morning...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, I need to balance the 
flow of qi with feng shui and make both my 
mind and body healthy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, first let's purify the 
'northeast' direction! Clean, clean☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, moving makes my headache so much 
worse...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Copano Rickey was troubled by a 
headache..."
